Hey everyone,

<https://www.governance.ai/|GovAI> is hiring! We’re looking for individuals who are interested in accelerating or launching impactful careers in AI governance and policy. Applications for our three-month fellowships programs in UK and DC are open for another week.

Please find further details by clicking on the web links below and forward this message to anyone who you think may be interested in applying.

You can also directly recommend candidates <https://govai-referrals.netlify.app/|here>!

1. <https://www.governance.ai/post/uk-summer-fellowship-2027-research-track|UK 2027 Summer Fellowship, Research Track>
2. <https://www.governance.ai/post/uk-summer-fellowship-2027-applied-track|UK 2027 Summer Fellowship, Applied Track>
3. <https://www.governance.ai/post/dc-summer-fellowship-2027|DC 2027 Summer Fellowship>

*UK Summer Fellowship (7 June to 27 August 2027)*
Summer Fellows join GovAI on the <https://www.governance.ai/post/uk-summer-fellowship-2027-research-track|Research Track> or <https://www.governance.ai/post/uk-summer-fellowship-2027-applied-track|Applied Track> in London for 3 months to conduct independent projects with mentorship from leading experts in the field. Each fellow is paired with a supervisor from the GovAI team or network. UK visa sponsorship is available. The deadline to apply is 23:59 GMT Sunday 22 November 2026.

*DC Summer Fellowship (7 June to 27 August 2027)*
Summer Fellows join GovAI in Washington, DC for a <https://www.governance.ai/post/dc-summer-fellowship-2027|3 month bipartisan opportunity> to deepen their understanding of the field, connect with a network of experts, and build their skills and professional profile, all while conducting a research project of their choice under expert guidance. Candidates need the right to work in the US. The deadline to apply is 11:59 PM ET Sunday 22 November 2026.

Rare opportunity to join Arrow research as a Member of Technical Staff.  These guys are doing groundbreaking work, so if you are a steller researcher or engineer that wants to be on the frontier of AI safety, this org is hard to beat: <https://arrowresearch.ai/careers|https://arrowresearch.ai/careers>

My friends at <https://www.arimlabs.ai/|Arimlabs> have raised a $5M pre-seed and are looking to hire safety people to lead their research on the impact of different RL environments for alignment. They offer competitive salaries + equity.
Reach out to <mailto:jobs@arimlabs.ai|jobs@arimlabs.ai> if interested.

Emeryville is right around the corner (fun fact, Pixar Animation is there too) <https://x.com/AsteraInstitute/status/2121285945681199241?a=mombJvCT_eb1qC8q0-0&s=19|x.com/AsteraInstitute/status/2121285945681199241?a=…&s=19>

Passing on an A\ opportunity:
> Anthropic has <https://alignment.anthropic.com/2026/anthropic-residency/|opened applications for the Anthropic Residency>, a paid, fixed-term research program of six weeks to six months for established technical leaders who want to move into AI safety. As models improve, AI safety research will increasingly rely on the ability to frame a research agenda and make high-level judgements on what’s worth doing, so they’re particularly keen to hear from professors in quantitative disciplines, technical founders and staff-level engineers. No ML background is required. Applications close on 22 November 2026, and you can apply here: <https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic/jobs/5438311008|US> or <https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic/jobs/5439169008|UK>. Know someone who’d be a good fit? You can refer them using this <https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSftwsZjNy6ej04Y5T8Y_yOevdSP5B_WKhDuwG8XrpimAyhM-w/viewform|referral form>.

*<http://chipsforhumanity.org|Chips for Humanity> wants to help ai safety people get compute.*

Please tell us about you compute needs, _whether you already have enough compute or not_.

We have made a survey trying to answer:
1. How much compute the field needs (minimal version)
2. Whether we can help with getting you compute (slightly longer version)
This form is low effort and can be completed in 3 minutes. Please try your best estimate (erring towards lightly overestimating rather than under).
The responses will give us the AI safety field data we need to start deciding how much compute to plan to get. Don’t worry about having multiple people in your org fill out the same form, we will do our best to aggregate it :)

*Survey:*
<https://survey.chipsforhumanity.org|survey.chipsforhumanity.org>

> Hi all! *<https://www.projectmycelium.ai/|Mycelium>* is hiring for multiple roles, including *<https://www.projectmycelium.ai/careers/research-scientist-engineer|Research Scientists/Engineers>* and a *<https://www.projectmycelium.ai/careers/chief-science-officer|Chief Science Officer>* to join our team. We work on advancing robust moral values in AI character, with a particular focus on the _welfare of neglected beings,_ like digital minds and nonhuman animals. Our most recent <https://www.mantabench.org/|benchmark> is currently being used by GDM.
> 
> We’re especially looking for people with:
> • Strong empirical ML research track record and conceptual reasoning abilities
> • Hands-on experience building evals: designing tasks and scenarios, writing rubrics, setting up LLM judges, and thinking about construct validity
> • Excellent technical writing and external communication
> • Mission-aligned and concerned about the long-term welfare of nonhuman beings
> 
> For more info on roles and to apply:
> • *<https://www.projectmycelium.ai/careers/research-scientist-engineer|Research Scientist/Engineer>* - Deadline: Dec 1st eod aoe.
>     ◦ *Salary:* $130k–$320k
> • *<https://www.projectmycelium.ai/careers/chief-science-officer|Chief Science Officer>* - Deadline: Dec 5th eod aoe.
>     ◦ *Salary:* $295k–$450k
> • *Location:* Bay area (hybrid, 3 days/week in office); remote considered for exceptional candidates
> 
> Feel free to DM me if you have any questions!

(Courtesy of Maureen Ahmed)

From Transluce:

Transluce is hiring <https://jobs.gem.com/transluce/am9icG9zdDqP0MXhYKi0ri8jx_-Atqvs|Frontline Evaluators> for our embedded assessment teams. Our assessments will have privileged access to frontier labs in order to assess the comprehensiveness and rigor of their safety and alignment stack.

Evaluators will work in focused sprints, and core responsibilities will include surfacing novel behaviors from frontier models, developing and assessing evaluations, and authoring reports to inform the technical community and broader public. We’re especially looking for people with:
• Excellent empirical judgment and attention to detail
• Deep understanding of model behavior
• Ability to move quickly and produce results under uncertainty and tight timelines
This first round of embedded independent assessments is a crucial opportunity to set precedent for the future of third-party oversight. We hope that third-party oversight will become an important part of the ecosystem that keeps AI safe, by identifying open questions and producing evidence that shapes safety standards, research priorities, and public awareness of frontier AI development. Let me know if you or anyone you know could be a good match for this work!

• Must be willing to work in-person in San Francisco
• Salary: $270k - $600k
Apply: <https://jobs.gem.com/transluce/am9icG9zdDqP0MXhYKi0ri8jx_-Atqvs|Frontline Evaluator>
Questions? Email <mailto:selena@transluce.org|selena@transluce.org>
